Title: The neverending story of the Ghoul Retainer

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
On vtes-l, Robert Goudie writes:
> Here's the situation. Minion A (has retained a Ghoul Retainer) brings
> a Zip Gun into play and then the oppossing minion manuevers to long
> range. Minion A manevers back to close range with the zip gun. Minion
> A now plays an Immortal Grapple. Minion A is committed to the zip gun
> strike but cannot use it because of the IG. So, Minion A gets no
> strike. Can the GR on Minion A make use of the Zip Gun?

No. GR cannot use a weapon that his employer is using, and his employer
used the weapon for the maneuver (committing his use of it for his strike).

> Other GR questions? (I know they're gonna complain when I play this)
>
> Minion A cannot be Rotschrecked if the GR plays a Dragon's Breath
> Rounds, right?

Correct. But that's because the DBR doesn't do anything (!) except burn the
weapon. (I just noticed this myself when you asked the question.)

Card text (VtES) on DBR:
Minion inflicts +2 aggravated damage ...

Since the GR is not a minion, he doesn't get any bonus for DBR.

> Even though the GR is using a weapon the damage is considered
> "retainer damage" and cannot be prevented with Skin of Steel, correct?

Correct. The damage from the GR is "environmental".

--

> >
> ummm....but DB also doesn't mention the weapon when it mentions the
> damage. so would the _minion_ get +2 agg damage to whatever strike he
> used, as long as the GR uses a DB on the gun that the GR's using? (i
> know this makes no sense, but it seems to be what one might be able to
> wrangle out of card text..)

Well, I wouldn't go this far. It's restricted to "play when damage from
a gun is being resolved. This minion..." So is only played when a minion
uses a gun.

But, as with the melee weapon template, the effect is still over-stated.

A minion with a Bastard Sword does not get +1 hand damage on any old
strike - only on strikes with the Bastard Sword.
Similarly, a minion using DBR doesn't get +2 aggravated damage on
any old strike, only on strikes with the gun loaded with DBR.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:

> Well, I wouldn't go this far. It's restricted to "play when damage from
> a gun is being resolved. This minion..." So is only played when a minion
> uses a gun.

*** Oops ***
Sorry, overstating things again.
*** ***

DBR can be played during the damage resolution of a GR gun use.
But, as the +2 agg damage each strike only applies to "this
minion", it will not benefit the employer of the retainer.
(There is no "this minion" for the damage from the GR).

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
